Paper.purpose: A clay surface for grouping content. The root forwards native attributes such as id, class, style, aria-* and data-*. Use class or style to customize --clay-color, --clay-d or --clay-radius; use as for native semantics.

as.description: Native root element; choose a tag that matches the content.

variant.description: Outlined uses a themed border and no shadow, regardless of elevation.

elevation.description: Depth: 0 is flat; 1, 2 and 3 set 6px, 10px and 16px respectively.

square.description: Use square rather than rounded corners.

inflated.description: Enable SVG dome shading. Ignored for outlined or elevation=0; otherwise render ClayLighting once in the document.

events: No component events; listen on the native element in a client script.
Native handler props such as onclick are forwarded to the root; no component events.

Button.purpose: Use a native button for actions or an anchor for navigation. Keep visible label text or provide an accessible name for icon-only content. Native id, class, style and aria-* attributes pass through.

variant.description: Raised color fill, themed outline, or transparent text at rest.

color.description: Semantic palette color; contained inherit uses the standard clay surface with inherited text color.

size.description: Controls spacing, depth, radius and minimum height (36px, 48px or 56px).

href.description: A nonempty URL renders an anchor instead of a button. Disabled or loading anchors omit href and receive aria-disabled="true" and tabindex=-1; do not override these state attributes.

target.description: Link target; use only with href.

rel.description: Link relationship; use only with href.

type.description: Native button type; omitted or null means button. Use submit or reset explicitly for the associated form. Ignored when href renders an anchor.

disabled.description: Disables a native button; disables navigation and removes the anchor from sequential focus when href is set.

loading.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy="true" and makes the control behave as disabled.

loadingPosition.description: Spinner placement while loading. Center visually hides the label and icons without removing them.

disableElevation.description: Removes the outer shadow at rest while preserving inset shading on non-text variants.

inflated.description: Enable SVG dome shading; render ClayLighting once in the document.

events: Native click; no component script or callback prop. Removing href prevents disabled link navigation but does not block custom click logic.
onclick(event): native click handler prop, not invoked while disabled or loading. Other native handler props are forwarded.

Checkbox.purpose: A native input[type=checkbox] with clay styling. Supply an accessible name using a wrapping label, a label with for matching the input id, or aria-label. Forwards native input attributes including id, class, style, aria-* and data-*; do not supply type. Mixed state is independent of checkedness and does not determine form submission.

color.description: Semantic palette color for the checked or mixed state.

size.description: Visual box size: 24px for small, 28px for medium.

checked.description: In Astro, sets both the initial checkedness and the form reset default. In Svelte, is live state (bind:checked is supported); use defaultChecked to set a separate form reset default.

defaultChecked.description: Initial checked state when checked is omitted. Svelte also uses it as the reset default; Astro resets to the state rendered on the input.

indeterminate.description: Astro's client script sets the initial mixed state; clicking clears it and form reset restores it. In Svelte the parent owns this prop: on change and reset the client restores the current prop, not its original value.

disabled.description: Native disabled state; prevents interaction and form submission of this field.

required.description: Native form validation requires the checkbox to be checked.

name.description: Form field name. A checked, enabled checkbox with a name contributes its value.

value.description: Native submitted value (serialized as text). Defaults to on when omitted; not the checked state.

form.description: Id of the associated form when the input is not nested in it.

events: Native change event on the input; attach listeners in a client script. No component callback prop.
astro.example:
<form>
  <label><Checkbox name="updates" value="yes" defaultChecked /> Email updates</label>
  <button type="reset">Reset</button>
</form>

events: onchange(event): native change handler, called first.
onChange(event, checked): Svelte callback after onchange, with the input's current checkedness. Use bind:checked to track form resets as well as user changes.
svelte.example:
<script lang="ts">
  let checked = $state(true);
</script>

<form>
  <label><Checkbox name="updates" value="yes" bind:checked defaultChecked /> Email updates</label>
  <button type="reset">Reset</button>
</form>

ClayLighting.purpose: Defines the document-wide #clay-lit SVG filter for inflated surfaces. Render once per document only when inflated shading is used. Do not put it under display: none. It has no props, content, events or native attribute forwarding.
